cases.summary: User selects Re-identification from Customer Services
cases.preconditions: Logged in on staging with EnvConfig inventory agent (PDV) after PIN validation
cases.expected: Re-identification starts and asks for customer MSISDN. Allowed profiles: POA, Dealer Shop, Team Leader, Staff.

cases.summary: Active MSISDN uses OTP with 60s timer, 5 min expiry, resend after timer, max 5, then 10 min wait
cases.input: 1. Reach OTP. 2. Observe timer. 3. Wait for resend. 4. Use EnvConfig for OTP values, never workbook secrets.
cases.expected: OTP sent to customer MSISDN. Timer default 60 seconds. Expiry 5 minutes. Resend after timer. Maximum 5 resends per session. After max attempts wait 10 minutes.
cases.traceability: SAA-921; REQ-004; Active MSISDN – OTP Flow

cases.summary: Invalid OTP shows the quoted message and ends the flow
cases.expected: Message: "Invalid OTP. The code you entered is incorrect. Please check the OTP and try again." If OTP verification fails, the flow ends.

cases.summary: Inactive MSISDN uses habit questionnaire; both answers must be correct
cases.input: 1. Enter the MSISDN. 2. Answer most frequent contact (one or two MSISDNs) and latest airtime or bundle reload correctly.
cases.expected: Habit questionnaire is shown. Both answers must be correct to continue.
cases.traceability: SAA-921; REQ-006; Inactive MSISDN – Customer Habit Questionnaire

cases.summary: Failed questionnaire shows the quoted message and only Cancel
cases.expected: Message: "Reidentification not authorised. Customer identification failed." Only Cancel is available. User cannot continue.

cases.input: 1. Scan National ID, Foreign Passport, CEDEAO, Refugee as available. 2. Fail OCR and retry.
cases.expected: Those ID types are supported. Front and back where required. Mandatory data from OCR or scan. If OCR fails, user can retry.
cases.traceability: SAA-921; REQ-008; ID Scanning and OCR

cases.summary: Mandatory KYC fields block continue; Country and Address are editable
cases.input: 1. Leave ID Type, First Name, Last Name, Date of Birth, or ID Number empty. 2. Edit Country and Address.
cases.expected: User cannot proceed until mandatory data is complete. Country and Address are editable.
cases.traceability: SAA-921; REQ-009, REQ-010; KYC Form Rules

cases.summary: Unauthorised document shows the quoted message
cases.expected: Message: "Document not authorised. Please use another ID card to register client."

cases.summary: SIM threshold 3 blocks with the quoted message and Home redirect
cases.expected: Message: "Sim threshold reached. Customer not allowed to register new numbers." User is redirected to Home.

cases.summary: Below threshold, PIN submits and receipt is shown
cases.input: 1. Enter PIN. 2. Observe receipt. 3. Download. 4. Share.
cases.expected: Receipt: Certification Status On Going; SIM Activation Status Sim Activated; Message SMS will be shared to client, once certification is realised; Transaction ID. Download and Share available.
cases.traceability: SAA-921; REQ-013, REQ-014; Transaction Completion / Receipt

cases.summary: History records type, ID, date/time, certification status
cases.expected: Each re-identification is recorded with transaction type, Transaction ID, date/time, certification status.

cases.summary: Not counted in performance by default
cases.input: 1. Check whether the transaction incremented performance KPIs.
cases.expected: Re-identification should not be counted in performance dashboard by default. Inclusion is configurable from Admin Portal by agent type (portal itself is REQ-020, not this case).

cases.summary: Feature flag, OTP timer, expiry, resend limits
cases.input: 1. Locate feature activation, OTP timer and expiry, OTP resend limits.
cases.expected: Not testable from the mobile app. No portal steps.

cases.summary: Comment records GetSubscriberInfo SSL failure — environment, not a product expected result
cases.input: 1. Start Re-identification for an eligible MSISDN.
cases.expected: Comment 2026-08-13 documents SSLHandshakeException on GetSubscriberInfo. That is an environment/API failure, not an acceptance criterion. If it still occurs, classify ENVIRONMENT, do not invent a UI message.
